post.text: JUST IN: 🇷🇺🇮🇷 Russia took multiple satellite images of US Prince Sultan Air Base in Saudi Arabia days before Iran attacked, NBC reports. https://t.co/Hx2iTHKrxB

description.description: A close-up portrait of Vladimir Putin wearing a dark blue suit, a light blue shirt, and a dark patterned tie. He is looking towards the camera with a slight smile.

A digital illustration of a cylindrical satellite with gold and silver metallic paneling and two blue rectangular solar arrays. The satellite is positioned in low Earth orbit, reflecting light against a backdrop of deep space filled with stars and a distant galaxy. Below the satellite, the curvature of the Earth is visible with a blue atmosphere and white cloud formations.
